description:
Optimized Power for Effortless Commuting
The BK2 delivers a refined riding experience tailored for European cities. Its 250W hub motor provides a smooth, legal boost up to 25 km/h, while 5 pedal-assist modes allow you to customize your effort. Whether you are tackling a 25° incline or cruising to a café, the power delivery is intuitive, ensuring you arrive fresh and sweat-free.
Ultra-Portable Magnesium Alloy Design
Engineered for the "last mile," the BK2 features a durable magnesium-aluminium alloy frame that strikes the perfect balance between strength and portability. At just 22.7 kg, the quick-fold design is perfect for transitioning from the street to the metro, office, or car trunk. It supports a payload of up to 100 kg, making it a robust companion for daily errands.
Maximum Comfort with Dual Shock Absorption
Don't let cobblestones or rough bike paths ruin your ride. The BK2 sets itself apart with a dual suspension system (front fork and rear shock), providing superior cushioning that many compact e-bikes lack. This "floating" ride feel, paired with an ergonomic adjustable saddle, ensures that even longer trips across patchy city surfaces remain comfortable and stable.
Certified Safety & STVZO Lighting
Safety is non-negotiable. The BK2 is TÜV-certified and comes standard with STVZO-compliant LED lights for maximum visibility in European traffic. The front and rear disc brakes provide high-performance stopping power, while the integrated display keeps vital stats like speed and battery life clearly in view, allowing you to focus on the road ahead.
Removable Battery & Versatile Utility
Experience the freedom of flexible charging. The 36V 7.8Ah lithium battery is seamlessly integrated into the frame for a sleek look but can be removed for indoor charging—perfect for shared buildings or offices. With a generous range of 35–70 km and a sturdy factory-installed rear rack, the BK2 is the ultimate value-for-money choice for sustainable urban mobility.
